scope: All 16 selected original KOF98 characters and every frozen action window. Window counts are observations, never completed moves or recovered skeletons. Motion trigger, native timing, hitboxes, cancels and damage stay open per window.

specialsScope.scope: 16 characters/155 official partial variants; input attempts, not complete moves or successful execution

remainingByDesign: all named normals and their near/far range variants

actual native timing and complete sprite frame coverage

declaredMissing: all named normals and near/far variations
